content: STAAD .std input deck is a free-format text file (space-separated tokens, max 24 chars, ; for multiple entries per line, * comments, blank+hyphen line continuation for lists only). STAAD SPACE/PLANE initiates problem. JOINT COORDINATES: joint number + X Y Z (Z optional for PLANE). MEMBER INCIDENCES: member number + start/end joint, with REPEAT/REPEAT ALL generation commands. MEMBER PROPERTY: PRIS YD ZD (YD alone=circular, YD+ZD=rectangular), TABLE ST W14X90 (lookup key into external steel db - .std does NOT contain geometry), PIPE/TUBE/USER/TAPERED variants, modern files use quoted db filenames. SUPPORTS: joint list + PINNED/FIXED/FIXED BUT/FX/FY/FZ/MX/MY/MZ/SPRING. LOAD/LOADING n TITLE: MEMBER LOAD (UNI GY -2.5 = uniform, global Y by default local), JOINT LOAD (FX/FY/FZ/MX/MY/MZ), SELFWEIGHT, LOAD COMBINATION. UNIT is stateful (default FEET KIPS; can switch mid-file). GROUP definitions (_NAME) group members for lists. Bentley hard limits: 400k joints, 500k members, 10,101 load cases; practical guidance ~20k members.
